fc1.title: ALSVID FC1 step-through carbon folding e-bike
fc1.description: Meet the ALSVID FC1: a low-step carbon frame, compact folding design and suspension at both ends. Figures shown describe the reference model; final retail specifications will be published once confirmed.
fc1.heading: A little lower. A lot more open.
fc1.intro: A low-step frame. Compact folding. Front and rear suspension. More freedom for every day.
fc1.photo.alt: Side view of a green 20-inch low-step carbon folding e-bike with seven-speed chain drive
fc1.photo.note: Seven-speed chain reference bike shown. Final sales configuration is listed with the product.
fc1.gallery: A closer look. From every angle.

fc1.colours.title: Colour should feel like yours.
fc1.colours.body: The photos show the green reference build. ALSVID FC1 production colour and finish are being finalised. Swatches below collect colour preferences; they do not represent available stock or open orders.
fc1.colours.proposal_selected: Colour direction selected: {colour}. We will update the product photos when the ALSVID FC1 finish is confirmed.
fc1.colours.none_selected: The photos show the green reference build. Confirmed ALSVID FC1 colours will be announced here.
fc1.colours.disclaimer: Colour directions are for preference only. Available colours, paint codes, finishes and launch timing are pending confirmation by ALSVID.
fc1.section.entry.title: Step through and set off.
fc1.section.entry.body: A low-step carbon frame and 20-inch wheels make getting on and off feel effortless.
fc1.section.fold.title: Ready for the ride. Ready to tuck away.
fc1.section.fold.body: From the daily commute to weekends away and storage at home. Unfold for the ride. Fold to make more room.
fc1.fold.caption: Folding dimensions are model reference values. Follow the FC1 manual when folding.
fc1.section.detail.title: Comfort and control live in the details.
fc1.section.detail.body: Front and rear suspension follow the contours of the bike, bringing a clean silhouette and a comfortable ride together.
fc1.hotspot.front.body: Suspension sits within the fork profile, keeping the front end clean while softening feedback from the road.
fc1.hotspot.rear.body: A compact air shock works with the rear suspension to soften changing road surfaces.
fc1.hotspot.chain.body: The photograph shows the seven-speed Shimano chain sample. This is not a photograph of the optional single-speed belt configuration.
fc1.hotspot.controls.body: Handlebar controls and a central display keep the cockpit clear. Display model, assist modes, ingress rating and connectivity will follow the final FC1 specification.
fc1.section.drive.title: Every pedal stroke. A natural response.
fc1.section.drive.body: Torque-sensing assistance follows your pedalling, adding natural support to everyday rides.
fc1.market.title: Market specification
fc1.market.body: This preview presents the European no-throttle reference setup. Other motor options are not currently planned as FC1 retail configurations. The ALSVID published specification will define the available model.
fc1.section.battery.title: Removable energy, neatly integrated.
fc1.section.battery.body: The battery fits into the seatpost for a clean silhouette. A removable design makes everyday charging more convenient.
fc1.battery.range_note: ¹ Up to 80 km is the reference maximum on the standard battery, not a guaranteed distance. Assist level, terrain, rider weight, weather and riding style affect actual range.
fc1.section.config.title: A drivetrain to suit your ride.
fc1.config.chain.title: Seven-speed chain sample
fc1.config.chain.body: The photos show the seven-speed chain reference build. Reference weight is 15.5 kg including battery and kickstand. Final FC1 weight will be published with the retail specification.
fc1.config.belt.title: Single-speed belt option
fc1.config.belt.body: A single-speed belt drive is a possible reference build, with a stated weight of 14.5 kg including battery and kickstand. A matching photo and FC1 retail availability are not confirmed.
fc1.config.note: Drivetrain, accessories, weight, retail variants and availability will be announced before FC1 goes on sale.
fc1.section.specs.title: Get to know every detail of FC1.
fc1.section.specs.body: These figures provide an overview of the reference build. Retail specification, destination market, compliance documents and included accessories will be confirmed before launch.

fc1.section.faq.title: Before the first ride, you might ask…
fc1.faq.0.q: What is the recommended rider height?
fc1.faq.0.a: The reference fit range is 160–190 cm, with a maximum rider weight of 120 kg. Before ordering, check that the fit and saddle adjustment work for you.
fc1.faq.1.q: Is the bike 14.5 kg or 15.5 kg?
fc1.faq.1.a: The photographed seven-speed chain reference is 15.5 kg. The optional single-speed belt reference is 14.5 kg. Both figures include the battery and kickstand.
fc1.faq.2.q: How large is the bicycle when folded?
fc1.faq.2.a: Reference folded dimensions are 85 × 69 × 48 cm. Measurement axes, tolerance and accessory position for FC1 are being confirmed.
fc1.faq.3.q: Does it have suspension at both ends?
fc1.faq.3.a: The reference lists integrated carbon-fibre front suspension and a DNM rear air shock. Exact model, travel and tuning need final build confirmation.
fc1.faq.4.a: No. It is a stated maximum for the standard 36 V 10 Ah battery. Actual range depends on assist, route, rider weight, weather and riding conditions.
fc1.faq.5.q: Can the bottle battery run at the same time as the seatpost battery?
fc1.faq.5.a: In the reference setup, a bottle battery operates separately from the seatpost battery. Whether this option will be offered for FC1, and how it works, is still being confirmed.
fc1.faq.6.q: Is the European certification already confirmed for ALSVID FC1?
fc1.faq.6.a: CE / EN 15194 documents and their scope for ALSVID FC1 are being reviewed. We will make no compliance claim until the exact model and retail specification are confirmed.
fc1.faq.7.q: When will colours, prices and online orders be available?
fc1.faq.7.a: We will publish colours, retail versions, pricing and availability in the ALSVID shop as soon as they are confirmed, then open ordering.
